data.animaCaption: Shiki Natsume presents a pastry in an opaque folded kraft-paper pouch with both cupped hands above her cafe apron. Her gentle smile remains the waist-up focal point. White cups sit in wooden racks at staggered distances behind the counter, with the nearer rack edge overlapping the shaded wall. Warm cafe light picks out the pouch folds and cup rims, while hand-to-paper shadows and soft reflected wood light keep the offering clear.
data.negative: transparent pouch, duplicate pastries, fused cupped hands

data.story: 【官方 CG 灵感】杯架前，夏目把小点心仔细捧在掌心递来。「试吃品只有一份，」她微笑着补充，“所以你的评价要认真一点。”柔和的光落在她的黑色长发与琥珀色眼眸上，眼下泪痣也让克制的表情显得格外清晰。
data.storyJa: 【公式CGインスピレーション・夏目】柔らかな光の中で、彼女は大切な人だけに本当の気持ちを見せる。「目を逸らさないで。あなたにだけ、見ていてほしいの。」
data.title: 杯架前递来的点心
